# Mandatory repository handover gate

Before generating, editing, reviewing, or running code in this repository, read:

1. `00-READ-FIRST.md`
2. `HANDOVER-PROMPT.md`
3. `HANDOVER.md`
4. `AGENTS-PROJECT-RULES.md` and `CLAUDE-PROJECT-RULES.md` when present

The gate remains active while `HANDOVER.md` says `Status: ACTIVE` or `Status: BLOCKED`.
Do not infer missing Codex-thread content; re-verify GitHub and runtime evidence.
